tool.name: Wikitext formatter
tool.description: Format the selection, or the whole source when nothing is selected
dialog.title: Format wikitext
dialog.intro: Choose the optional formatting to apply. Safe basic fixes always run.
dialog.indentPipes: Indent each block-template nesting level by 2 spaces
dialog.alignFirstSeparatorTooltip: Align the name–value separator of the first named parameter on each line. Positional parameters have no separator to align.
dialog.subsequentParameterLayout: Subsequent parameters on the same line
dialog.alignColumnsTooltip: Align the top-level | separator that starts each corresponding parameter column, without aligning name–value separators.
dialog.alignColumnsCompletelyTooltip: Align parameter columns and the name–value separators of named parameters. Positional parameters participate only in column alignment.
dialog.characterRatioFiveToThreeTooltip: Use for typical Chinese fonts, where a full-width Chinese character is usually about 5:3 as wide as a half-width character.
dialog.characterRatioTwoToOneTooltip: Use for programming-oriented monospace fonts, where a full-width Chinese character is exactly twice as wide as a half-width character.
dialog.normalizeConversion: Normalize semicolons in Chinese conversion rules
dialog.resolveRedirects: Replace wikilink redirects with target page titles
dialog.resolveDescriptionAfter: . Use it only to repair links in navigation templates or similar cases that must point directly to target pages. The many API requests may noticeably slow formatting.
dialog.highlightMissing: Highlight links to nonexistent pages in red
dialog.highlightMissingDescription: Checks links when enabled and after editing stops. API requests run in the background.
dialog.fullPageReferencePreviews: Use whole-page source for reference previews
dialog.fullPageReferencePreviewsDescript: During section editing, loads the base revision to resolve references defined elsewhere on the page.
feedback.noEditor: No MediaWiki source editor was found.
feedback.openFailed: Wikitext formatter could not open. Try again.
feedback.selection: Wikitext formatting was applied to the selection.
feedback.whole: Wikitext formatting was applied to the whole source.
feedback.failed: Wikitext formatting failed. Review the source and try again.
feedback.settingsSaveFailed: Formatter settings could not be saved in this browser.
